name: Magic Touch Photo
description: Draw a green Keep+ lasso to preserve its selected area, or a red Keep- lasso to remove its selected area.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: MediaPipe Tasks Vision and MagicTouch model by Google

release_notes: Adds true lasso-based Keep+ and Keep- selection. Keep+ preserves the selected area; Keep- removes the selected area while preserving the rest. Retains compatibility with legacy positive/negative brush clients.
